     1	/-

     4	Authors: The AlgebraicJacobian Contributors
     5	-/
     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.StructureSheafModuleK.ModulesFunctor
     7	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.HilbertPolynomial
     8	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.LineBundlePullback
     9	
    10	/-!
    11	# Fibrewise truncated Euler indices for line bundles
    12	
    13	For a morphism `f : X ⟶ S`, a point `s : S`, and a sheaf of modules `M` on
    14	`X`, this file defines the degree-at-most-one Euler index of the restricted
    15	module `M_s` over the residue field `kappa(s)`.  For a line bundle `L` on a
    16	relative product, it also defines the signed difference
    17	
    18	`chi(L_t) - chi(O_{(C x_S T)_t})`.
    19	
    20	The definitions deliberately use the name *index*, not geometric degree.
    21	`CategoryTheory.Sheaf.chi` is totalized: without finite-dimensional `H0` and
    22	`H1`, `Module.finrank` can read an infinite-dimensional space as zero.  The
    23	line-bundle difference becomes the usual fibre degree only after the relevant
    24	cohomological finiteness and Riemann--Roch comparison are supplied.
    25	
    26	This file proves invariance under isomorphism of the underlying modules by
    27	using `Scheme.toModuleKSheafOfModulesFunctor` and the existing
    28	`CategoryTheory.Sheaf.chi_congr`.  It does not yet descend the difference
    29	through the relative Picard or etale equivalence relation, prove pullback
    30	naturality in the test scheme, or prove local constancy on that test scheme.
    31	
    32	## Main declarations
    33	
    34	* `Scheme.Hom.fiberEulerIndex`: the totalized truncated Euler index of a module
    35	  on a scheme-theoretic fibre.
    36	* `Scheme.LineBundle.OnProduct.fiberEulerIndexDifference`: the signed
    37	  line-bundle index relative to the literal structure sheaf of the fibre.
    38	-/
    39	
    40	set_option autoImplicit false
    41	
    42	universe u
    43	
    44	open CategoryTheory Limits
    45	
    46	namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme
    47	
    48	variable {X S : Scheme.{u}}
    49	
    50	/-- The totalized degree-at-most-one Euler index of the restriction of `M` to
    51	the scheme-theoretic fibre of `f` at `s`, computed over `s`'s residue field.
    52	
    53	No properness, dimension, or cohomological finiteness hypothesis is imposed,
    54	so this is not asserted to be the genuine Euler characteristic. -/
    55	noncomputable def Hom.fiberEulerIndex (f : X ⟶ S) (s : S)
    56	    (M : X.Modules) : ℤ :=
    57	  CategoryTheory.Sheaf.chi
    58	    (toModuleKSheafOfModules
    59	      (Over.mk (f.fiberToSpecResidueField s))
    60	      (f.fiberModule s M))
    61	
    62	/-- `fiberEulerIndex` is invariant under an isomorphism of modules on the
    63	total space.  The isomorphism is pulled back to the fibre, restricted to the
    64	residue field, and passed to `Sheaf.chi_congr`. -/
    65	theorem Hom.fiberEulerIndex_congr (f : X ⟶ S) (s : S)
    66	    {M N : X.Modules} (e : M ≅ N) :
    67	    f.fiberEulerIndex s M = f.fiberEulerIndex s N :=
    68	  chi_toModuleKSheafOfModules_congr
    69	    (Over.mk (f.fiberToSpecResidueField s))
    70	    ((Modules.pullback (f.fiberι s)).mapIso e)
    71	
    72	namespace LineBundle.OnProduct
    73	
    74	/-- The signed, normalized fibre index of a line bundle on `C x_k T`:
    75	`chi(L_t) - chi(O_{(C x_k T)_t})`.
    76	
    77	The second term uses the literal unit module on the fibre, rather than a
    78	definitionally different pullback of the unit module on the total space.  This
    79	is the cohomological expression that Riemann--Roch identifies with degree once
    80	finiteness and the curve comparison are available.  At this stage it is only
    81	a totalized truncated index and has not descended to the relative Picard
    82	functor. -/
    83	noncomputable def fiberEulerIndexDifference {k : Type u} [Field k]
    84	    {C T : Scheme.{u}} (piC : C ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    85	    (piT : T ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    86	    (L : LineBundle.OnProduct piC piT) (t : T) : ℤ :=
    87	  let q := pullback.snd piC piT
    88	  q.fiberEulerIndex t L.carrier -
    89	    CategoryTheory.Sheaf.chi
    90	      (toModuleKSheafOfModules
    91	        (Over.mk (q.fiberToSpecResidueField t))
    92	        (SheafOfModules.unit (q.fiber t).ringCatSheaf))
    93	
    94	/-- The normalized fibre index is invariant under an isomorphism of the
    95	underlying line-bundle modules.  This is the iso-invariance needed before a
    96	later descent to line-bundle isomorphism classes; it does not prove invariance
    97	under tensoring by a bundle pulled back from `T`. -/
    98	theorem fiberEulerIndexDifference_congr {k : Type u} [Field k]
    99	    {C T : Scheme.{u}} (piC : C ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
   100	    (piT : T ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
   101	    {L L' : LineBundle.OnProduct piC piT}
   102	    (e : L.carrier ≅ L'.carrier) (t : T) :
   103	    fiberEulerIndexDifference piC piT L t =
   104	      fiberEulerIndexDifference piC piT L' t := by
   105	  dsimp [fiberEulerIndexDifference]
   106	  rw [Hom.fiberEulerIndex_congr _ _ e]
   107	
   108	end LineBundle.OnProduct
   109	
   110	end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme
